content:
Use Claude + Fable to generate a hyper-detailed character identity description (down to pores), then feed that identity into Seedance 2.5 to rebuild the same base video around the new character while preserving motion, cuts, and audio.

To create multiple variations quickly, keep the same source video and swap only the prompt (e.g., “new girl, one prompt”; “new room, one prompt”; “new winner to clone, one prompt”) to generate frame-for-frame consistent edits in Seedance 2.5.
